reuse.why: Reuses ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse and bankSync.syncAccount, but the upgrade-or-insert/sync/notify body and the download function are copied from the existing providers instead of shared.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkEnableBankingAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, and the new starting-balance branch copies the akahu branch in processBankSyncDownload.

placement.why: Handlers, download and server URL go where the other providers' do, but SyncServerFintegraAccount is declared in models/simplefin.ts rather than its own or a provider-neutral module.

scope.why: Focused on the provider, with one adjacent edit widening DbAccount.account_sync_source to unrelated existing providers.

maintainability.why: Matches the tree's per-provider copy convention, so it is familiar, but it adds a sixth copy of the link flow and a fifth copy of the download/balance logic to keep in step.
